verdict: Two-site locality plus Z2 link parity allows h B H2 and forbids the named elementary fillers, and it protects every connected endpoint path. It is not a selector for the full invariant ring. The degree-six factorized invariant (h Omega H2) Tr(A B Omegabar^T) is allowed and nonzero because Tr(A0 B0)=-6; it restores the direct weak mass and rank40. Pure-link determinant/cofactor contractions pass, but adjoint factorization kills the design. Minimal running is also poor. No gate is promoted.
